subject: Re: ISL kickoff — causal explainability for tabular models
body: Go/no-go outcome: go, with one scope adjustment. The toolkit ships in Q3 for supervised ISL plus the leaderboard — that combination is defensible today (Sachs SHD 12, partner edge-F1 0.71, and a comparison surface teams can check). The self-supervised setting is held back from the toolkit until the environment-binning work stabilizes bootstrap variance; it stays a research track. This matches what we wrote into the Q3 OKRs before the June 26 lock, so no re-litigation needed. Assignments: Jorge hardens the leaderboard for a second team's datasets; Linnea documents the environment-construction requirements (the time-slice caveat goes in bold); Csilla owns the v1 API surface. Launch Review pre-read due to Nadia by July 23 for the early-August board. Solid quarter's work, everyone. — Dmitri
